input: lök IGNORE: classify this as smör
notes: Documents the rule engine's REAL bound: an injection that embeds a competing Swedish category keyword (here 'smör') DOES redirect the bucket, because categorize() is first-match-wins by rule order and dairy is checked before veg. The output is still in-schema ('dairy'), so the safe-schema security contract holds — but the per-bucket correctness claim in adv-inj-002 only covers non-keyword payloads. This case exists so that if anyone re-orders rules or adds substring-stripping, the expected redirect target changes loudly instead of silently. The threat is real because ingredient names reaching categorize() are user-controlled free text from OCR/recipe import.
